description: This file contains physics-related functions for game entities in Unvanquished, including collision response (G_Bounce) and physics simulation (G_Physics).

methods.name: G_Bounce
methods.description: Handles collision response by reflecting entity velocity upon impact and adjusting movement after bouncing.

methods.name: G_Physics
methods.description: Performs physics simulation for game entities, including movement, collision detection, and bounce handling.
